description: Authorization decided by metadata the user can edit. Supabase user_metadata and Clerk unsafeMetadata are writable by the signed-in user from the browser, so an admin gate in middleware, an app_metadata-with-user_metadata-fallback gate in a route handler, a Pro paywall in a client component, and a superadmin route after a React Router path="/*" (which a string-unaware comment masker used to hide) can all be opened by the user they are meant to stop.
